# SPIKEWorkbench pull request

## Change

Describe the user-visible behavior and any SPIKE worker contract affected.

## Checks

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] `python tools/package.py --kind install --output <new-zip-path>`
- [ ] FreeCAD kernel or GUI check for affected integration behavior
- [ ] Result status, units, provenance, and unsupported cases remain accurate
- [ ] Added assets have source, owner, license, and redistribution rights recorded
- [ ] Commit includes a real DCO `Signed-off-by:` line

## Evidence and limits

Link the fixture, screenshot, or measured result and state any remaining validation limit.
